snippet.title: “Clinically Studied”… But Did They Count Babies?
snippet.description:
Every supplement bottle sounds sure of itself: “supports egg quality,” “clinically studied.” But a supplement can give you one more egg, or a nicer-looking embryo, without giving you more babies. Eggs, embryos and babies are three different things. Next time a label says “clinically studied,” ask one question: did they count babies?

Full video: https://youtu.be/2hjpsL0bwhM
Full article: https://draksoyivf.com/blog/coq10-melatonin-nac-oocyte-quality-ivf/
